titel: Chase Sapphire Preferred Just 'Refreshed' [2026] — Is it still worth it?

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Chase Sapphire Preferred changes transfer ratios to Hyatt and adjusts perks and fees.
kurzfassung: Chase is overhauling the Sapphire Preferred card with new earning categories, higher credits, and added insurance, alongside negative changes like a reduced 4-to-3 transfer ratio to Hyatt and the removal of the anniversary bonus. These adjustments mean cardholders lose significant value on Hyatt redemptions, prompting strategic pivots toward other cards or programs. Despite the added complexity, the card remains a viable option for beginners who can maximize the new perks.
stichpunkte: The transfer ratio from Ultimate Rewards to Hyatt changes from 1-to-1 to 4-to-3 for new cardholders on June 15, 2026, and for existing cardholders and Ink Preferred users on October 1, 2026.
The 10% anniversary bonus on the Chase Sapphire Preferred is eliminated starting October 1st for existing cardholders.
New earning rates include 3x points on gas, EV charging, and vacation home platforms like Airbnb and VRBO starting June 15th.
New perks include emergency evacuation insurance capped at $100,000, a $120 trusted traveler credit every four years, a doubled $100 hotel credit, and one year of Apple TV.
Cardholders transferring 100,000 points to Hyatt lose significant value, translating to roughly one lost hotel night at popular properties like the Hyatt Regency Maui.
Strategy options to bypass the 4-to-3 ratio include upgrading to or applying for a Sapphire Reserve, utilizing household point transfers before deadlines, or exploring non-Hyatt redemption avenues.
Eligibility rules allow opening a Sapphire Preferred even if holding a Reserve, though lifetime restrictions on welcome bonuses remain strict.

clips.text: Starting June 15, 2026, newly issued cards will devalue points transferred to World of Hyatt, shifting from equal parity to a three-to-four reduction.

Recent promotional bonuses on the Sapphire Reserve reached 150,000 points—over twice the longstanding 60,000-point baseline—amid fleeting opportunities to route shopping portal earnings into hotel stays.
Emergency medical transport is vital when traveling abroad, but this policy's $100,000 limit often falls short of real-world evacuation expenses.

clips.hook: The Cost of the Ratio Change
clips.text: The downgraded point conversion rate to Hyatt effectively wipes out enough balance to cost travelers an entire free night's stay.

clips.hook: Maximizing Reserve Credits in Year One
clips.text: Cardholders can triple dip on semi-annual ticket and restaurant allowances during their opening year, helping offset the steep $795 membership fee.
